units.source_text: 這些詞語雖說是奇妙的組合，卻是事實。

en.t: Though these words made a strange combination, they were the truth.

units.source_text: 這位學畫畫的學生名叫堀木正雄，出生於東京的平民居住區，長我六歲，

en.t: This art student was named Masao Horiki; he had been born in Tokyo's working-class district and was six years older than I was,

units.source_text: 畢業於私立美術學校，由於家裡沒有畫室，所以他好像在這個繪畫教室繼續學習油畫。

en.t: and after graduating from a private art school, since he had no studio at home, he apparently continued studying oil painting at this painting school.

units.source_text: 我們雖然彼此相識，但只見過幾次面，且從未說過一句話。

en.t: Although we knew each other by sight, we had only met a few times and had never exchanged a single word.

units.source_text: 我不知所措地掏出五元錢。

en.t: At a loss, I took out five yen.

units.source_text: 我無法拒絕，被他拽進了繪畫教室附近蓬萊町的咖啡酒吧，

en.t: Unable to refuse, I was dragged by him into a cafe-bar in Horai-cho near the painting school,

units.source_text: 我們倆的交往就這樣開始了。

en.t: and that was how our association began.
"I had my eye on you from the start.
